resources.string: Aligns subtitles with the dialogue when Auto Sync can\'t find a reliable match.
Optional. Recognizes English speech and compares the dialogue with external English subtitles for faster, more precise sync. May increase CPU and memory usage.
Downloaded. Delete it to go back to audio analysis only if CPU or memory usage is too high.
Download failed. Select to retry. Speech detection still works.
Listens during playback only, so sync takes longer. mpv needs Low or High.
Reads a few dialogue samples ahead of playback over one extra connection, up to 75 MB per title. Also used instead of High on metered networks.
Fastest sync. Reads more samples over several connections, usually up to 150 MB per title, and uses more CPU. Some hosts limit connections.

Speech detection uses Silero VAD v5 weights (MIT, Silero Team). Optional speech recognition uses sherpa-onnx (Apache-2.0, k2-fsa) and its Zipformer GigaSpeech English model (Apache-2.0). Full notices ship with the app in licenses/audio_sync_NOTICE.md.
